_comment: Per Steam App ID deploy capabilities. Enable a capability for a new game here; do not add Python App ID whitelists. normalize_mod_folder_name maps the library folder name through services.mod_path_normalizer (ASCII pinyin). There is no game-specific folder rename in Python. sync_project_xml_title rewrites target project.xml <Title> after Apply using .info/metadata.json display_name. paradox_launcher_activation documents Paradox Launcher Workshop enable/order sync (Stellaris, CK3); runtime config lives in services.paradox_activation.PARADOX_LAUNCHER_GAMES. native_modsettings_order documents BG3 Patch 8 modsettings.lsx order (AppID 1086940); runtime is services.bg3_activation via services.order_backend. flat_pak_layout copies *.pak to game.mod_path by basename (BG3). folder_copy games without this flag keep the Mod folder, even when the payload is a .pak. kcd2_mod_manifest_root deploys the directory that contains mod.manifest directly under game.mod_path (Kingdom Come: Deliverance II).
